title: Mood and energy log
audience: For anyone who wants to see what lifts them and what drains them.
description: An evening mood and energy log. Tell your AI about your day in your own words and it scores and logs it in Amber Notes.
tagline: A short evening check-in that shows patterns.
seoTitle: Mood and energy log template for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Mood and energy log

A short check-in each evening. After a few weeks, the patterns show what lifts you and what drains you.

<!-- pane-table: Date=date; Mood=scale 1-5; Energy=scale 1-5; Sleep (hours)=number; Caffeine=choice None|1 cup|2 cups|3+ cups; What happened=text -->
| Date | Mood | Energy | Sleep (hours) | Caffeine | What happened |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Patterns

prompt.default: Use my Amber Notes note "Mood and energy log". Each evening I'll tell you about my day in my own words. Log one row with log_table_row: Mood and Energy from 1 (low) to 5 (great), Sleep in hours, Caffeine as one of the options, and one short line in What happened. If you're unsure about a score, ask me instead of guessing. When I ask about patterns, read the table with read_table and add what you notice under "Patterns" with append_to_note. Don't give medical advice.

asks: Today was long but good. Slept 6 hours, two coffees, great lunch with Maja.
What do my best days have in common?
Does caffeine change my energy the next day?

values.What happened: Long day, great lunch with Maja

args.text:
- Energy follows sleep: under 6 hours, energy was 2 or lower.
- Three cups of coffee came on the lowest day, not the busiest one.

A short check-in each evening. After a few weeks, the patterns show what lifts you and what drains you.

| Date | Mood | Energy | Sleep (hours) | Caffeine | What happened |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2026-09-28 | 4 | 3 | 6 | 2 cups | Long day, great lunch with Maja |
| 2026-09-29 | 2 | 2 | 5.5 | 3+ cups | Deadline, skipped the walk |
| 2026-09-30 | 4 | 4 | 8 | 1 cup | Slept in, finished the report |

## Patterns
- Energy follows sleep: under 6 hours, energy was 2 or lower.
- Three cups of coffee came on the lowest day, not the busiest one.
